# Continuous integration

[ci.yml](ci.yml) checks out the repository, provisions JDK 21 and sbt, and runs `sbt verify packageArtifacts` on pushes and pull requests. Verification checks formatting, compilation with fatal warnings, and tests; packaging generates the three module binary/source JARs and POMs. Separate archive and isolated-consumer checks are recorded in the [build acceptance](../../project/README.md#local-artifact-packaging); the workflow does not perform those inspections or publish artifacts. Remote workflow execution must be checked separately from local validation. Semantic FP correctness and review approval remain mandatory manual gates.
